findings.title: The till line names no tills and nothing compares Shelfmark with what the owner does now

location.description: the "Works with your till" fact line under the table

findings.viewer_experience: An owner whose till or card reader is not named assumes it is not supported. Nothing tells them why this beats walking the shelves on Monday or reading the till's own sales report.

current.value: The line says "Works with your till. Sales come in from the shop's card reader as they happen." It names no till or card reader, and no line compares Shelfmark with what the owner does now.

findings.target: The line names the supported tills or card readers, and one line compares Shelfmark with what the owner does now. The maker must supply both: the names of the supported tills or card readers, and the comparison facts.
findings.fix_direction: The maker names the supported tills or card readers and adds one line that compares Shelfmark with what the owner does now. Only the maker has these facts; do not invent them.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports, the "Works with your till" line names the supported tills or card readers, and one line compares Shelfmark with what the owner does now.

findings.title: Nothing answers the Pricing and "Shops using it" links, and the bottom third of the screen is blank

location.description: the empty area below the fact lines

findings.viewer_experience: The bottom third of the screen is blank on desktop and widescreen, and a visitor who wants to know the price has to click away.

current.value: Content ends at about y=530 of 800 on desktop and y=530 of 1080 on widescreen.

findings.target: A short pricing and shops section below the fact lines. The maker must supply the pricing facts and the shop facts.
findings.fix_direction: Add a short pricing and shops section below the fact lines, with pricing and shop facts that the maker supplies.

closed_when.check: In the desktop and widescreen viewports, a pricing and shops section sits below the fact lines and the bottom of the screen is no longer blank.

findings.title: Tablet fact lines end on one or two words

location.description: the fact lines under the table, where "they happen." and "and when." sit alone on their last lines

findings.viewer_experience: Short last lines of one or two words make the fact lines look ragged and unfinished.

current.value: The lines are 544 px wide; "they happen." and "and when." sit alone on their last lines.

findings.target: No fact line ends with one or two words on the tablet.
findings.fix_direction: Narrow the lines a little more, to about 32em, or let them run to the 600 px width of the table above them so they rebalance. Then check that no line ends with one or two words.

closed_when.check: In the tablet viewport, no fact line ends with one or two words alone on its last line.
